_comment: Traffic with NO business context (no bpmn.* / business.* baggage, no process or task spans), sent by src/unlabeledClient.js as 'dealer-workstation'. Each user action is its own trace; the only link between a session's actions is the session.id the applications record. BPMN IQ (GET /api/undefined-processes) groups sessions, maps each call to the API catalog, and compares the sequence with every established flow.
vacantNote: vacant: an established flow, run exactly as modeled, with an empty header (no baggage).
deviationNote: deviation: an established flow with one change: skip a step, swap two adjacent steps, or repeat a step (rework).

emergent.name: Self-Service Lease Buyout
emergent.description: Lessees go from the lease-end notice straight to buying the car out, skipping the inspection, and finance the buyout through the credit flow.

emergent.name: Service-Lane Trade-Up
emergent.description: While a customer's car is in for service, staff appraise it as a trade-in and present a new-vehicle offer with financing.
